description: This file contains unit tests for various shared utility functions related to daemon container context resolution, runtime status coloring, and CLI hint filtering within a project. It uses the Vitest testing framework to verify expected behaviors of functions such as resolveRuntimeStatusColor, resolveDaemonContainerContext, renderGatewayServiceStartHints, and filterContainerGenericHints.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeStatusColor
methods.description: Maps runtime states ('running', 'stopped', 'unknown', 'degraded', undefined) to theme color constants.

methods.name: renderGatewayServiceStartHints
methods.description: Generates hints for restarting or managing daemon containers based on environment variables.

methods.name: resolveDaemonContainerContext
methods.description: Resolves the container context string from environment variables.

methods.name: filterContainerGenericHints
methods.description: Filters out generic hints related to container foreground operation when specific container environment variables are set.
